body.name: io.github.zvmzaretsky/utility-belt
body.title: FabTally Utility Belt
body.description: 13 deterministic agent utilities: timezone, cron, RRULE, currency, regex, diff, hashing & more.
body.access: open: a streamable-http endpoint that needs nothing from the caller

tools.name: convert
tools.description: FREE. Convert a value between units in the same dimension: length, mass, temperature, volume, data, time, area, speed, angle, pressure, energy. Deterministic. A

tools.name: text
tools.description: FREE. Text transforms. op='slugify' -> URL slug; op is one of camel|pascal|snake|kebab|constant|dot|path|title|sentence|upper|lower for case conversion; op='tem

tools.name: hash
tools.description: FREE. Compute a cryptographic digest: sha256, sha512, sha384, sha1, md5, sha3-256, keccak256, ripemd160. Optional HMAC via hmac_key. Output hex (default), base6

tools.name: encode
tools.description: FREE. Encode or decode text. op is one of base64-encode|base64-decode|base64url-encode|base64url-decode|hex-encode|hex-decode|url-encode|url-decode|html-encode|

tools.name: id
tools.description: FREE. Generate identifiers. kind is one of uuidv4|uuidv7|ulid|nanoid|hex|base64url|int. count up to 1000. nanoid takes `size`; hex/base64url take `bytes`. Uses

tools.name: regex

tools.name: timezone
tools.description: PAID $0.001 (x402, USDC on Base). Convert an instant between IANA time zones with historically-correct DST. Returns converted datetime, UTC offsets, tz abbrevia

tools.name: cron
tools.description: PAID $0.001. Parse a 5- or 6-field cron expression and return the next N run times plus a plain-English description. Args: expression, timezone (IANA, default U

tools.name: rrule
tools.description: PAID $0.001. Expand an iCal RRULE (RFC 5545) recurrence into its next N occurrences. Args: rrule (e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10'), after (ISO, default

tools.name: currency
tools.description: PAID $0.001. Convert an amount between currencies at reference/mid-market rates from a keyless public central-bank feed (ECB), cached. Informational, not a deal

tools.name: diff
tools.description: PAID $0.001. Diff two texts: a unified patch, a structured op-list (add/remove/equal), and add/remove/hunk stats. Args: a, b, mode (lines|words|chars, default l

tools.name: jsonschema
tools.description: PAID $0.001. Validate a value against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) and explain every error in plain English (which property, what was wrong, allowed values). A

classes.title: The digest of a text, from an MCP server in the official MCP registry
classes.det: the call carried the task’s text and algorithm (task_bound) && the tool reported no error (no_tool_error) && the reply holds the digest code recomputes from the task’s text (digest_exact)

body.how: POST /v1/handshake { candidate: { address: "io.github.zvmzaretsky/utility-belt", kind: "mcp-registry" }, task, tool, args, dispatch: true }
